mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_image (goods_id, image_url, sort_order, is_primary, create_time) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{isPrimary}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT image_id AS imageId, goods_id AS goodsId, image_url AS imageUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_primary AS isPrimary, create_time AS createTime FROM goods_image WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY is_primary DESC, sort_order ASC, image_id ASC
SELECT image_url FROM goods_image WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY is_primary DESC, sort_order ASC, image_id ASC
